# Thunderbird exact CardDAV, MessageTracker, and selected-state Phabricator reviews

D322940 consistently converts selected state from value-based strings to presence-based boolean attributes across Calendar, Mail, themes, tests, and FeedItem markup. The focused enabled-a11y suites passed; `browser_syntheticViews.js` failed in both original and inverse-tabmail experiments at unchanged setup (`TypeError: can't access property "view", window.gFolderDisplay is undefined`), so it is not causal patch evidence. [Task 4]

Scope: general.
